title: Four Got On. FIVE Got Off 🎟️
description:
Four tickets, five riders on the platform. Check the cones and the shadows, and pick one before the wheel comes round. Find the extra one, #2.

It's made up. A blocky puzzle, built with code and Blender.
pin: Which rider was the extra, A to E? What gave it away first for you, the cone or the shadow?
